_note: agent-harness#1710 permitted golden delta: extend the claude_channel `session_model_unbound` disclaimer in `claude_route_warnings` to disclaim recorded effort (`selected_effort`, `requested_effort`, `policy_effort`, `effective_effort`) alongside `selected_model`. `current` -> `pre_1710` restores the golden as it was before; nothing else moved.

changes.current: session_model_unbound: the claude-channel `send` transport binds neither `--model` nor `--effort`; the run inherits the operator's ambient claude session model and effort. `selected_model` and the recorded effort fields (`selected_effort`, `requested_effort`, `policy_effort`, `effective_effort`) record the INTENDED tier settings, NOT launch-bound ones (a send cannot rebind an existing session).
